Is more potent against Gram-positive bacteria (lethal concentration (LC=1.5-10.9 µM) than against Gram-negative bacteria (LC=6.2-50 µM), and fungi (LC=25.1-8.3 µM). Is lethal to the fungus Beauveria sp (LC=1.9 µM), a highly lethal pathogenic fungus to insects and resistant to many AMPs. Shows hemolytic activity against rabbit erythrocytes and cytolysis against rat dorsal root ganglions. In vivo, intravenous injection into mice tail provokes uncomfortable symptoms with a death rate of 12.5%.
Tissue specificity: Expressed by the venom gland.
